title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Own-Notice Window for a Health-Care Absence
content:
When the start date of a borrower's health-care absence is fixed on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, the **own-notice window** turns on two records:

- **A** — an occupancy inspection was ordered on the profile with an order date less than twelve whole calendar months before the handling date;
- **B** — the monitored borrower (the profile's primary borrower) has exactly one accepted health-care absence notice on file.

| A | B | Own-notice window |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 30 days |
| yes | no | 21 days |
| no | yes | 21 days |
| no | no | zero days |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

*Hypothetical case.* The borrower has two accepted health-care absence notices on file and an inspection was ordered eight months ago: A holds and B does not, so the window is 21 days.
